summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting top-line results from Phase III trials of Ultomiris (ravulizumab) in HSCT-TMA. The adult/adolescent trial (ALXN1210-TMA-313) missed its primary endpoint of event-free survival at 26 weeks, while the pediatric trial (ALXN1210-TMA-314) showed meaningful overall survival (87.2% at 26 weeks, 73.4% at 52 weeks). No financial terms, transactions, or corporate actions are involved. This is routine clinical trial disclosure by a foreign private issuer under Form 6-K, not a special situation. Discussions with health authorities are ongoing regarding data interpretation and regulatory filings for the pediatric indication.
